title: Common-stage compact support with canonical Weil structures
statement:
Fix the finite-field datum $D=(p,a,q,k_0,k)$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne p$, and an algebraic closure $\Omega$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, with no equality imposed between the scheme and coefficient universes. For finite-type $k_0$-schemes use the actual common-stage constructible categories and the categories of geometric-Frobenius fixed pairs [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex]. Use the geometric-fibre inverse image $P_f=f^*$ and its normalized Frobenius square $P_fF_X\simeq F_YP_f$ of [def-zl-weil-ind-sheaf-category].

For a proper morphism $p_0:X_0\to Y_0$, $P_p$ has a right adjoint $R_p$ on these common-stage constructible categories; choose it together with its adjunction. Define $e_p:R_pF_Y\to F_XR_p$ to be the right mate of the inverse normalized pullback square under $P_p\dashv R_p$. This mate is invertible. For an open immersion $j_0:X_0\to Y_0$, $P_j$ has a left adjoint $J_j$, chosen with its adjunction. Define $d_j:F_XJ_j\to J_jF_Y$ to be the left mate of the normalized pullback square under $J_j\dashv P_j$; it is invertible, and put $e_j=d_j^{-1}$. These adjunction universal properties determine the chosen operations up to unique compatible natural isomorphism; no arbitrary comparison is chosen.

For $f_0:X_0\to Y_0$ and a compactification $c=(j_0,p_0)$, use the middle $k_0$-scheme and the two $k_0$-arrows constructed in [def-zl-weil-compact-support-cohomology]. Define $H_{f,c}=J_jR_p$ in diagrammatic functor order (first $J_j$, then $R_p$). Its Frobenius comparison $e_{f,c}:H_{f,c}F_Y\simeq F_XH_{f,c}$ is $J_j(e_p)$ followed by $e_jR_p$, with the ordinary associators. Define its functor on Weil fixed pairs by $(K,\theta)\mapsto(H_{f,c}K,e_{f,c,K};H_{f,c}(\theta))$ and by $H_{f,c}$ on underlying morphisms. For a separated finite-type $f_0$, for every geometric compactification $c_g$ and every normalized coefficient action $S$ [def-weil-compact-support-coefficient-action] on that compactification, $H_{f,c}$ is naturally isomorphic, on every object and morphism, to $S$'s common-stage functor of [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support]. Finally, for composable maps and chosen compactifications, define the Frobenius comparison of the iterated functor $H_fH_g$ by $H_f(e_g)$ followed by $e_fH_g$, with the associators.

source.place: First two paragraphs: proper image and compact support Weil structures from invertible automorphism-square exchanges; together with SGA 4 XVII §5–6 proper/open construction

proof.text: For zlPull_proper_isLeftAdjoint specialize the existing sfModelPull_isLeftAdjoint to the proper map. The existing result already holds without properness or separated structure morphisms, so no extra hypothesis is used.

On each geometric fibre finite type gives Noetherianity, finite topological dimension and stalk invertibility of ell. Obtain the coherent coefficient comparison system and apply commonStageDerivedPullback_identity. The normalized pullback compositor applied to geometric Frobenius and its inverse gives both inverse-composition isomorphisms. Functor.IsEquivalence.mk' therefore proves that this actual common-stage Frobenius pullback is an equivalence.

Apply CategoryTheory.isIso_mateEquiv_of_isEquivalence to the inverse normalized Frobenius square and the two proper adjunctions. This proves invertibility of the specified proper mate, without changing its definition.

Choose a normalized coefficient action for the open identity compactification using sfCompactSupportFiniteFieldIndependence. Apply openWeilUnitAndEmptyFibre to this action and take the adjunction field of its common-stage OpenData. This is a left adjoint of the literal zlPull, so its adjunction gives zlPull_open_isRightAdjoint. The open theorem works with independent scheme and coefficient universes; the unnecessary separated structure-morphism hypotheses are removed in the same delivery.

Given the recorded open adjunction, apply CategoryTheory.isIso_inverseMate_of_equivalences to the normalized Frobenius square, using the two Frobenius equivalences just constructed. This proves invertibility of the specified inverse open mate.

Choose normalized support actions Sj and Sp for the open and proper factors by finite-field independence. The generalized existing open-unit package gives Sj ⊣ Pj. For proper Sp, construct finite rational adjunctions from the identity-open tower comparison and normalize their counits with the prescribed coefficient maps. The proved stage-mate unit/counit construction descends this finite adjunction to Pp ⊣ Sp. Adjoint uniqueness identifies the parent chosen functors Jj and Rp with Sj and Sp. Apply the existing field shriek compositor for these three arbitrary compactifications, transporting the composite arrow along the geometric compactification equality. Whiskering the adjoint-uniqueness isomorphisms and composing with this compositor proves the recorded comparison. Retain the displayed ordered Frobenius paste.

The proper coefficient-counit normalization is a separate finite-stage lemma. Preserve the proper adjoint and Frobenius mate proofs and the unit route.
